conformal_ambiguity: the forward map is invariant under g -> Omega^2 g, so the inverse returns a conformal class representative and the gauge is reported
forward_map: Plebanski-Tamm: eps^ij = mu^ij = -sqrt(-g) g^ij / g_00, w_i = -g_0i/g_00
inverse_map: closed form h = det(eps) eps^-1 in the g_00 = -1 gauge, valid for w = 0 only
units: Heaviside-Lorentz, c = 1; vacuum is eps = mu = I
validity_condition: g_00 < 0 required; fails where v_s f > 1
